subject: Regional Exec Alignment — Satellite Sessions & Travel Corridors
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed cadence + satellite sessions for November workshop

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the time last week. Following our discovery, the team here sketched a plan to run the two-day executive workshop the week of Dec 7. We want to propose a primary onsite day (Dec 9) in Palo Alto for the exec core, with a set of satellite virtual sessions on Dec 8 and Dec 10 to include ops and product teams across EST and CET.

High-level asks:
- Can your execs confirm preference for Dec 9 (onsite) as the anchor day?
- Will the two execs you mentioned (CEO + Head of Product) arrive on Dec 8 late evening or Dec 9 early AM? We need arrival windows for airport pickup and security passes.
- AV needs: projector + two-way video bridge for CET participants; backup Zoom link required.

I’ve attached a quick mutual-action-plan outlining responsibilities and a site-visit pass template so your security team can pre-clear visiting execs. If it helps, we can hold short calendar blocks (2 hrs) for each timezone with explicit shuttle windows — we typically recommend the following travel corridor approach:
  * East coast execs: arrive Dec 8 (18:00–22:00 PT), hotel block checkout Dec 10 afternoon
  * EU execs joining virtually: satellite session at 08:00 PT / 17:00 CET

If Dec 7 week is tight, we have limited availability the week after (Dec 14) but prefer the earlier date to align with our Q4 deliverables.

Next steps: Sophie, if you can confirm dates and lead travel windows by Monday EOD we’ll publish calendar holds and send the recommended flight ETA windows to your travel team.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
vivk.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: mutual-action-plan_v1.pdf, site-visit-pass-template.docx

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed cadence + satellite sessions for November workshop

Vivek — quick notes from ops:

1) Venue note: Palo Alto lab has limited on-site parking for executive vehicles; recommend hiring a car service with a 4-hr standby window (arrive, park, drop). We can book through our partner (Lyft Concierge) and include the cost in the M*A.

2) AV: request two separate VPN bridges for the main room (one for EU video bridge, one for a low-latency audio channel). Also add a recording consent sign-in sheet — our legal team wants explicit consent for recordings.

3) Hotel blocks: Hyatt (10 rooms) + The Cardinal (5 rooms, exec suites). Suggest we mark hotel hold codes in the site-visit pass template so Orchid can route to their travel desk.

4) Security: if Orchid needs HSPD-style badges, add the employee badge number field to the pass template.

I'll slot calendar holds once Sophie confirms. Grace — can you draft the calendar descriptions (with travel corridors and shuttle windows) and share the Drive link?

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success Operations 
monica.patel@redwood.ai

From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@orchidhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Proposed cadence + satellite sessions for November workshop

Vivek — thanks for the clear outline and the MAP. Orchid is good to proceed the week of Dec 7. Confirming:

- Dec 9 works as the anchor day for our execs.
- CEO (Sophie Martin) will arrive late on Dec 8 (ETA SFO 21:30 PT) and needs airport pickup + hotel transfer.
- Head of Product (Tom Rivera) is aiming for early morning Dec 9 (ETA SFO 07:40 PT). He will need space to prep in the morning — a private green room for 90 minutes would be ideal.

For the satellite sessions: we need a 60-minute slot on Dec 8 at 14:00 PT / 17:00 ET for our operations leads, and a 75-minute CET-friendly panel at 09:00 PT / 18:00 CET on Dec 10. Please confirm whether the AV vendor can support the staggered bridges; also confirm whether the recording will be stored in Orchid's secured Drive or Redwood's workspace (we prefer Orchid retention).

Security note: Orchid requires a minimum 48-hour lead time for visitor badge print. I’ve attached our travel authorization form (separate). We’ll share exact traveler passport numbers after internal clearance.

Sophie
Sophie Martin, VP Strategy, Orchid Health
sophie.martin@orchidhealth.com | +1 617-555-0234

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@orchidhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed cadence + satellite sessions for November workshop

Thanks Sophie — perfect. We’ll proceed with the Dec 9 anchor and the two satellite slots you outlined. Action items we’ll take immediately:

- Monica: secure Hyatt + Cardinal holds, publish hotel codes to shared Drive (target: EOD Wed 11/18).
- Ops: book car service for late-night pickup (CEO) and early-morning pickup (Head of Product). Provide 60-min pickup buffer windows in calendar event.
- Grace: create calendar holds (90-min green room for Tom on Dec 9 AM; Dec 8 ops slot 14:00–15:00 PT; Dec 10 CET panel 09:00 PT / 18:00 CET) and include shuttle windows in the description.
- Security: we’ll mark site-visit-pass-template with a 48-hour print note; Sophie please send passport numbers to security@redwood.ai when ready.
- AV vendor: confirm two bridges + local recording dump to Orchid's secure Drive; Monica will chase vendor confirmation and post the vendor contract link in the Drive.

I’ve updated the MAP with these commitments and uploaded it to the shared link below. I’ll also create explicit calendar events with the travel corridor labels ("SFO arrival corridor — 18:00–22:00 PT", "SFO morning prep — 06:30–08:00 PT").

Shared links: https://drive.redwood.ai/Shared/OrchidHealth/ExecWorkshop/Itinerary v1
HubSpot: https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/DEAL-73452

Looking forward to the runbook — I’ll send the finalized calendar holds by Wed EOD.

Best,
